works.author: Artspire
works.comment: 深色高级感加皮沙发上的拉花大图，只留一个 Check Menu 主按钮，靠生活场景卖品牌调性而不是堆商品格。
works.comment_en: Dark premium feel plus a big latte-art-on-leather-sofa shot, with only one 'Check Menu' button — selling brand tone through lifestyle scenes instead of product grids.
works.title: Premium Coffee Shop Website & E-commerce Design

works.author: Wegrow
works.comment: 主视觉就是一块米色斑点折叠 3D 造型，靠材质和留白撑高级感，适合 SaaS 落地页用一个造型代替一堆截图。
works.comment_en: The hero is a single beige speckled folded-3D form — material and whitespace carry the premium feel. A good SaaS trick: one sculptural form instead of a pile of screenshots.
works.title: Mark OS Landing Page

works.author: Ilias Miah
works.comment: 一屏分层放车队状态、逾期动作和 AI 建议，顶部 206/240、61% 这种大数字加红色 Review 按钮做行动入口，信息密度很能打的 dashboard 范本。
works.comment_en: One screen layers fleet status, overdue actions, and AI suggestions; big numbers like 206/240 and 61% up top plus a red Review button as the action entry — a dashboard template with serious info density.
works.title: From Fleet Data to Actionable Decisions | EquipFlow Dashboard

works.author: George Railean
works.comment: 用 WebGL 地球晨昏线做氛围，先给“全球实时感”的情绪再给数字，适合需要开场气势的数据产品。
works.comment_en: A WebGL globe with a day-night terminator sets the mood — 'global real-time' emotion before the numbers. Made for data products that need an opening punch.
works.title: Product Animation: Live Dashboard & 3D Globe in WebGL

works.author: Samuel Oktavianus
works.comment: 宝蓝加亮粉撞色配大字标语，把硬核生物科技讲成人话，移动端多屏排版值得抄。
works.comment_en: Royal blue clashing with hot pink plus big-type slogans — hardcore biotech translated into human language; the multi-screen mobile layout is worth stealing.
works.title: ordivalabs: Biotech Automated Drug Discovery - Mobile UI

works.author: Conceptzilla
works.comment: 首屏不放产品截图，直接放一句 prompt 输入框让人马上能试，底下用 10x、65% 这种数字背书，AI 产品落地页的现成套路。
works.comment_en: No product screenshot up top — just a prompt input box so visitors can try it immediately, with 10x and 65% style stats underneath for proof. A ready-made AI landing-page playbook.
works.title: AI Agent Website Design
